root_cause.text: The per-item info buffer allocated on the stack is not zeroed before being passed to the per-connection visitor, so any fields the visitor does not write (including implicit alignment padding) remain as uninitialized stack data and are subsequently copied to user space via rds_info_copy(), leaking kernel memory.
